dialogue.text: Thank you for coming in — before we go further, if your breathing ever becomes severe or you feel chest pain, that's an emergency and you should call 911. When did the shortness of breath start, and is it worse when you lie flat?
The shortness of breath started about a month ago, and yes, it's definitely worse when I lie down flat at night. I've had to prop myself up with extra pillows just to sleep comfortably.
Have you noticed any weight loss, fever, or night sweats along with the abdominal swelling?
No, I haven't had any fever, night sweats, or significant weight loss. I've been feeling more tired than usual, but my weight has stayed pretty much the same.
Have you had any leg swelling, and have you noticed any vaginal bleeding or changes in your periods?
No, I haven't had any swelling in my legs. My periods have actually been pretty regular and normal - no unusual bleeding or changes that I've noticed.
Let me check your chest and get some imaging — REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray, and also REQUEST TEST: Pelvic_Ultrasound. Meanwhile, has your appetite or bowel habits changed at all?
